spiritgiven.comments: Excellent game. They were very nice and respectful and resolved all conflicts with respect and high spirit of the game.

General demeanor solid. There were several collisions during the game so some sentiment on our team that the could have played with a little more attention to avoiding harm but there was agreement that they were graceful in handling things when play was stopped.

Body contact came with an intense play. There were two times when it was lucky there was not someone hurt more. Yet to Surly’s credit they were good about talking about situations and agreeing on what to do. Communication and knowledge of rules high caliber.
When there were calls they were willing to adapt. String team, good clean play.
Helped us understand one of the rules more clearly. Very good about minimizing body contact and fouls.
Best game so far in terms of close score and camaraderie throughout!!
Hands down the most spirited team we’ve played. And above average on all 5 categories.  We’re currently in second place on SOTG behind Japan and it’s clear why they are beating us.
Our team felt 2’s for all five categories fit the SOTG for T Rex. It was a nail biter game and we really enjoyed playing them.
There was friction at the beginning of the game but kudos to the  captains (spirit and regular) for frequent check ins and a game that became more fair minded and spirited in the end.

SOUP is a team with great spirit and desire to play a tough but clean game.  Appreciated the SOTG that overlayed the competition.
